name: Acrobatic
description: Bonus on Acrobatics and Fly checks, larger at 10 ranks in the skill.

name: Alertness
description: Bonus on Perception and Sense Motive checks, larger at 10 ranks in the skill.

name: Combat Expertise
description: Trade melee accuracy for a dodge bonus to AC. Switch it on when you declare a melee attack. (Combat maneuver checks aren't modeled yet.)

name: Critical Focus
description: Bonus on rolls to confirm critical hits.

name: Bleeding Critical
description: Critical hits with slashing or piercing weapons cause bleeding.

name: Disruptive
description: Raises the DC for enemies to cast defensively within your threatened area.

name: Dodge
description: Dodge bonus to AC, lost whenever you lose your Dex bonus to AC.

name: Eschew Materials
description: Cast spells with cheap material components without needing them.

name: Great Fortitude
description: Bonus on Fortitude saves.

name: Improved Channel
description: Raises the save DC of your channel energy.

name: Improved Initiative
description: Bonus on initiative checks.

name: Iron Will
description: Bonus on Will saves.

name: Improved Iron Will
description: Once per day, reroll a Will save and keep the second result.

name: Leadership
description: Attract a cohort and followers.

name: Lightning Reflexes
description: Bonus on Reflex saves.

name: Magical Aptitude
description: Bonus on Spellcraft and Use Magic Device checks, larger at 10 ranks in the skill.

name: Mounted Combat
description: Once per round, use Ride to negate a hit on your mount.

name: Persuasive
description: Bonus on Diplomacy and Intimidate checks, larger at 10 ranks in the skill.

name: Power Attack
description: Trade melee accuracy for damage. The trade grows as your base attack bonus rises. (The extra damage for two-handed weapons isn't modeled yet.)

name: Cleave
description: After hitting a foe, make one extra attack against an adjacent foe, at the cost of AC.

name: Great Cleave
description: Like Cleave, but you can keep chaining attacks to adjacent foes.

name: Skill Focus
subject: Skill
description: Choose a skill. Bonus on checks with it, larger at 10 ranks.

name: Spell Focus
subject: SpellSchool
description: Choose a school of magic. Its spells are harder to resist.

name: Greater Spell Focus
subject: SpellSchool
description: Choose a school you already have Spell Focus in. Another bonus to its save DCs.

name: Spell Mastery
description: Prepare a few known spells without a spellbook.

name: Spell Penetration
description: Bonus on caster level checks to beat spell resistance.

name: Toughness
description: Extra hit points, with more for each Hit Die beyond 3.

name: Weapon Focus
subject: Weapon
description: Choose a weapon. +1 bonus on attack rolls with it. (Weapon proficiency isn't checked yet.)

name: Brew Potion
description: Create magic potions.

name: Scribe Scroll
description: Create magic scrolls.

name: Empower Spell
description: Increase a spell's variable numeric effects by half, using a slot two levels higher.
